definitions.gloss: to distract; to divert; to dispel
definitions.explanation: to take one's mind off something unpleasant by focusing on something else

examples.japanese: {寂|さび}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らわす。
⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らわす⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{本|ほん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read books to dispel boredom.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{没頭|ぼっとう}して→没頭する：18376_bottousuru⟧⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らわせた。
examples.english: I immersed myself in work to distract myself from grief.

notes:
USAGE:
- ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らわす (to distract from, to dispel)
- {寂|さび}しさ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らわす (to distract from loneliness)
- ⟦{退屈|たいくつ}→退屈：03389_taikutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らわす (to kill boredom)
- ⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{紛|まぎ}らわす (to distract from sadness)
Implies coping with negative feelings by redirecting attention. The underlying problem isn't solved, just temporarily set aside.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧)

- ⟦{紛|まぎ}らわしい→紛らわしい：06824_magirawashii⟧ (confusing, misleading)
